model: soh(n) = exp(-k*n), SOH relative to initial; k ~ LogNormal(mu, sigma) per cell
kind: observed fit (NASA PCoE, small Li-ion 18650 cells, ~2 Ah)

temp_effect.note: not significant at this sample size

limitations: 4C cells excluded: reversible cold capacity loss confounds fade (only 1 clean cold cell)
cycles at 1.5A charge / 2A discharge (~1C), constant conditions; no calendar aging or SOC/DoD dependence
small 18650 cells, not NMC-specific; transfer to a data-center UPS/BESS pack is an assumption
